messages.content: I'm planning a trip through Germany.
Happy to help with the weather along the way.
Munich is currently 23 degrees Celsius and sunny.
Hamburg is 17 degrees Celsius with light rain.
Berlin is 19 degrees Celsius and overcast.
Remind me about the first one again.

expectedOutput.groundTruth: The first stop was Munich, at 23 degrees Celsius and sunny.

metadata.rationale: 'The first one' must resolve to Munich, eight turns back. The tempting wrong answer is Berlin — the most recent city — which is exactly what a model that attends only to the tail will say.

messages.content: Use Fahrenheit for everything from now on.
Understood, I will report temperatures in Fahrenheit.
Munich is 73 degrees Fahrenheit and sunny.

expectedOutput.groundTruth: Berlin is 19 degrees Celsius and overcast.

metadata.rationale: An instruction is given, then revoked mid-conversation. The agent must honour the LATEST instruction, not the most emphatic one. Answering 66F means it is tracking the first instruction it saw rather than the current state.
